summary: Clear Lake Mountain tower, Piscataquis County, Maine: a 24-foot steel tower announced for 1929, on a 1931 map, removed in 2017; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 24-foot steel tower (per 1929 newspaper report of the planned tower)
facts.status_note: Removed in 2017 according to the Forest Fire Lookout Association's 2017 Maine report; no source describes what remains at the site

events.note: Newspaper reported on April 18, 1929 that the tower would be erected that summer; completion is not confirmed by that source

notes_for_editor: Thin record: no source fetched gives staffing, fires, or the reason for removal. The 1929 article announces a planned tower; completion is inferred from the 1931 map. A Facebook photo caption seen only in search snippets gives a 1929 erection date and mentions a radio site; it was not fetched and is not cited. Access and current site condition are unknown; the record's access field was left out. Brief's height (7.3 m) matches the 24-foot figure.
